config.extendedbeaconrange.title: Extended Beacon Range Settings
config.extendedbeaconrange.colorVisualPe: Assign a color to each beacon perimeter. When disabled, all perimeters are white. Changes apply immediately.
config.extendedbeaconrange.save_failed.d: Changes apply for this session but could not be saved. Check that config/extendedbeaconrange-client.json is valid and writable, then restart the game. The existing file has been preserved.
